text:
rachel (People Ops): Hi @kevin — sorry to hear about the divorce. We can remove your ex as a dependent via a QLE. Do you have the court divorce decree and the date of separation?
kevin ortega: Hey Rachel. Divorce finalized 2026-03-15. I have the final decree PDF and a signed separation agreement. I want coverage removed retro to the separation date if possible.
rachel (People Ops): We can request a dependent removal effective the date carriers allow. Carriers usually accept the divorce decree as proof for dependent removal. Upload the decree to the portal within 30 days of the QLE to be eligible for retro premium changes.
kevin ortega: If retro is approved, will I get a refund for premiums already paid this month? Also will COBRA be offered to my ex automatically?
samir khan: Payroll note: If verification completes within 30 days and the effective date is prior to the payroll deduction date, we can process a retro premium adjustment which shows as a correction on your next paycheck. It may appear as a negative premium line or separate refund depending on payroll timing.
samir khan: COBRA: carriers typically trigger COBRA for the ex-spouse if they were covered. HR sends the event to the COBRA admin once removal is processed; the ex will receive COBRA election paperwork directly from the vendor. We don't enroll them on COBRA on your behalf.
kevin ortega: Got it. How do I upload? Any naming or sensitive data concerns? The decree includes the ex-spouse	SSN in the filing.
rachel (People Ops): Use the secure upload path on the benefits portal and mark "contains sensitive info". Or send via encrypted email benefits@redwood-inference.com. Recommended filename: ortega_ex_divorce_decree_20260315.pdf
benefits-bot: Upload steps: Sign in > Benefits > Manage Dependents > Remove Dependent (QLE) > Upload proof -> Select "Divorce decree". Accepted formats: PDF/JPG/PNG. Max 10MB. Toggle "Contains sensitive info" if document includes SSN. Example UI snippet: ```Benefits -> Remove Dependent -> Upload -> Confirm```
kevin ortega: Uploaded ortega_divorce_decree_20260315.pdf and separation_agreement_20260301.pdf, marked as sensitive.
payroll-bot: Documents received. Case REF-2026-221 created. Estimated verification 2 business days. Payroll will evaluate retro adjustment upon benefits verification.
rachel (People Ops): Thanks @kevin. We'll confirm the removal effective date and any payroll refund timeline once carrier verifies. If COBRA vendor needs additional contact info for your ex, we'll let you know — you can provide a forwarding email or phone if comfortable. If you want us to redact or mask SSNs for the case file, tell us and we'll store only what's necessary for carrier submission. :thumbsup:
